title: Tomorrow is not promised.
paragraphs:
We speak as if we control time.
We plan next year.
We assume next week.
We even assume tomorrow.
“Now is the acceptable time… now is the day of salvation.” — 2 Corinthians 6:2

Salvation is not meant to be postponed.
Conviction is not meant to be ignored.
The call of God is not meant to be delayed.

Every day hearts grow harder.
Every day distractions grow louder.
And every day some people hear the truth… and say “later.”
But later is the most dangerous word in the human heart.
If God is calling you today, respond today.
